Private estate and country house documentation.

Estate Documentation

Significant private properties require documentation that matches their complexity — and the way they're managed. Alturascope works with estate owners, managers, and their architects to produce complete spatial records of private estates: interior and exterior, buildings and grounds, accessible spaces and those that aren't. Handled with the discretion these environments require.

What we document.

Main house interiors, outbuildings and estate structures, grounds and exterior envelope, inaccessible spaces within historic fabric, and services and infrastructure. For estates with historic structures, significant architectural detail, or where the documentation will inform conservation or restoration work, we capture using professional LiDAR instrumentation alongside the navigable digital twin — producing a record that your architects and contractors can take accurate measurements from. We document the estate as a whole — not just the principal building — producing a complete spatial record that serves renovation planning, estate management, and long-term preservation.

What you receive.

Navigable digital twin of all documented buildings, point cloud data where survey-grade accuracy is required, conditions report, equipment and services schedule, aerial documentation of exterior and grounds, labeled photo storyboard, and ScopeWalk access. All delivered through a secure portal with access controlled to your specifications.

Who this is for.

Private estate owners, estate managers, family offices, architects working on private estate projects, and landscape architects. Whether you're planning a renovation, documenting the estate for insurance or management purposes, or creating a permanent record of the property as it exists today.

How it works.

01

Clarify the brief

We align on what you need documented, what decisions the deliverable needs to support, and any access or sensitivity requirements.

02

Coordinate access

We handle all logistics — building access, security, travel, and scheduling. Travel costs are included in project pricing.

03

Capture the site

On site we follow a disciplined capture route through ScopeWalk — structure, services, equipment, conditions. Nothing missed.

04

Deliver and access

Complete deliverable package within three to five business days, permanently accessible through your ScopeWalk portal.

Frequently asked questions.

What does a private estate documentation survey include? +

A complete estate survey includes navigable digital twins of all documented buildings — main house and outbuildings — point cloud data where precision is required for architectural or conservation purposes, a conditions report, an equipment and services schedule, aerial documentation of the exterior and grounds, a labeled photo storyboard, and ScopeWalk platform access. The scope is tailored during the brief to match the estate's size, complexity, and your specific requirements.

Can you document outbuildings and estate structures as well as the main house? +

Yes. We approach an estate survey as a complete property documentation exercise, not just a survey of the principal building. Outbuildings, service buildings, estate structures, and grounds are all documented as part of the same project and delivered through the same ScopeWalk portal. This gives your team a complete estate record in one structured location.

How is the documentation delivered and who can access it? +

All documentation is delivered through ScopeWalk — our proprietary portal. Access is controlled to your specifications: you determine who can view the documentation and for how long. The portal is permanently accessible and does not expire. For estate management purposes, this creates a structured, secure record that your team can return to at any time.

Do you work in the UK as well as North America? +

Yes. We operate across all fifty US states and every Canadian province, with a dedicated UK operation covering England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Our principal has extensive experience with significant British private estates and historic properties, and that background shapes how we approach estate documentation on both sides of the Atlantic.

How is discretion handled on private properties? +

Discretion is assumed, not requested. We understand the sensitivity of private estate documentation and handle every aspect accordingly — from initial communication through to delivery and access control. No documentation is shared outside the agreed access list. No property details are used in marketing or public materials without explicit permission.

Tell us about your project.

Share the details of what you need documented. We'll come back with a clear scope and an all-in quote.
